name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) matches 'if you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first', so the exit cannot come before a toggle. Reaching the exit is only the condition of the 'if', so no Existence(at_exit) is needed, and the task does not require the switch when the exit is never reached, so no Existence(switch_toggled) either.

texts: If the agent reaches the exit, it must have toggled (flipped) the switch at an earlier step; the exit cannot be reached before a switch toggle has occurred.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
